behavioralInvariants: Use existing processor BF/DF oriented scribe crops first.
A missing, blank, structurally unusable, boundary-incomplete, or below-floor existing crop may enter only the bounded whole-wafer fallback.
A blank or wrong-location crop must produce no string and an explicit hold; never choose the least-bad OCR string.
Whole-wafer fallback uses source-pixel 2000x800 candidate crops and may inspect BF and DF, DARK and BRIGHT polarity, and bounded direction hypotheses.
Do not depend on notch alignment, a fixed notch-relative scribe position, die grid, repeating grid, or a solid line below the scribe.
A coherent structure score may prove that a crop contains a scribe band but may not choose OCR channel, polarity, direction, character, or identity.
Darkfield is not privileged; select only by image evidence while retaining close BF/DF alternatives as holds.
Never reconstruct, redraw, synthesize, or rank characters from artificial dot maps, threshold-component centroids, or hallucinated blob dots.
Checksum is VERIFY_IMAGE_FIRST_ONLY. It may verify or create a disagreement hold, but it may not rewrite a glyph, select a hypothesis, or rescue a weak crop.
Lot/MES information may locate candidate examples and verify an image-first read; it may not select the string.
R18H's generic run-structure tie-break applies to all body labels only when the two appearance leaders are within 0.02 and structural margin is at least 0.20; it is not a T/7 exception.
Any close-character change must regress all frozen visible strings, blank controls, blind strings, and leave-one-physical-identity-out references; never fix only the exposed pair.
Every result remains a proposal or hold with identityAccepted=false.
